curated.title: Roster culture: AVO| prefix and signup templates
curated.summary: Squad posts follow a fixed template — 'uid posisi nickname no wa' — and members style themselves AVO|<name> with a position (ST/CB/WF/GK). The convention started in the very first roster message and recurs in every tournament signup.

curated.title: Matchmaking ritual: lawan siapa / gas lawan X
curated.summary: Spar coordination has a fixed call-and-response: someone asks 'lawan siapa' (who's the opponent), someone answers with a rival name and 'gas'. Eclipse, Impact, AGI, Centra and Fision are the recurring sparring partners; 'Avoid League' schedule posts organize the fixtures.

curated.title: eFootball meta-talk: cut turn, long ball, fake shoot
curated.summary: Tactical coaching is constant: 'cut turn' before shooting, 'long ball' as the fallback against lag, 'fake shoot' tricks, and goalkeeper blame after every conceded goal ('kiper nya...').

curated.title: mandul — the signature roast
curated.summary: 'mandul' (barren) is the standard roast for an inactive team or player, nearly always paired with jir and the 🗿/🤣 reaction. 477 hits over 51 days, aimed at teams, opponents and friends alike.

curated.summary: The group runs on short coordination formulas: 'info mabar', 'info rank', 'p info main lah', 'yg main?', 'main kah', 'ayo mabar', 'jam brp/berapa' — always lowercase, always one line.
